name: Filesystem
shortdesc: Resource agent for WinDRBD filesystem mounts
longdesc:
This resource agent manages the online/read-only state of a WinDRBD
disk and assigns a mountpoint (drive letter or path) to one of its
partitions. It does not initialize, format, or partition the disk.

parameters.name: device
parameters.longdesc:
The DRBD device path used to identify the WinDRBD disk, e.g.
/dev/drbd0 or /dev/drbd0p2 for partition 2. The minor number
is extracted from this path.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.longdesc:
The mount point where the partition should be assigned, e.g.
D: or C:\ClusterData.

parameters.name: hyper_v
parameters.shortdesc: Skip clearing read-only flag (for Hyper-V shared storage)
parameters.longdesc:
If set to true, the read-only attribute of the disk will not be
cleared on start. This is needed when the disk is used as Hyper-V
shared storage managed by the HyperV resource agent.
